text: {"label": "Temporal Control and Schedule-Signaled Behavior","definition": "Research on how time and schedule-correlated stimuli control behavior, including interval timing, temporal discrimination, midsession reversal, schedule-induced behavior, lag schedules for variability, and multiple schedules signaling attention availability.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Emphasizes timing and stimulus signaling of schedule conditions, unlike general variable- and fixed-interval schedule theory, concurrent-schedule choice and contrast, or effects of reinforcement delay."}
